newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 5.

text.p: The cabinet will meet at 1000 GMT for what one government official described as "a first run round the course" on departmental spending totals for the 1997-8 financial year.
No agreement is expected without further meetings, and when one is reached, the details will not be made public until Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's November 26 budget statement.
Other events at Westminster today include -- - Health Department questions at 1430 GMT.
- Second reading of the Crime and Punishment (Scotland) Bill, starting about 1530 GMT.
- Education and Employment Committee publishes Government response to its report on Employment and Unemployment Statistics, 1200 GMT.
